label: Recovery of possession / eviction (住居・シンガポール)
service_note: originating claim / SCT notice は court service (post 含む) — SMS/WhatsApp の『court』通知は偽

deadlines.label: Possession claim への対応
deadlines.rule: landlord は自力 eviction できず、Conveyancing and Law of Property Act s.18 に基づき書面の termination notice (違反事由を明記) を serve した上で court order を要する。tenant が占有を続ける場合、退去は court order → enforcement order for possession (旧 writ of possession) → Sheriff/Bailiff の執行 + Notice of Eviction (vacate 日時) によってのみ。possession claim を受けたら通知/Rules of Court が定める期間内に応答
deadlines.anchor: Conveyancing and Law of Property Act s.18 + Rules of Court (enforcement order for possession)

options.label: possession claim に期間内に応答 (termination notice の適法性・breach・rent を争う)

landlord の self-help (lock change・cutting utilities・harassment) は違法 — illegal eviction は criminal trespass (罰金最大 S$5,000) + 民事責任; 退去は court order + Sheriff/Bailiff によってのみ; 受けたら police・lawyer・Legal Aid Bureau へ

referrals: 事由が複雑・illegal eviction / harassment → lawyer / Legal Aid Bureau / Community Justice Centre
